

Load Zhou et al data into Seurat

```{r eval=FALSE}

# load R packages
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)

# spatial plotting functions
source('/dfs7/swaruplab/smorabit/analysis/scWGCNA/bin/spatial_functions.R')
source("/pub/smorabit/hdWGCNA/bin/spatial_functions.R")


setwd('/dfs7/swaruplab/smorabit/collab/woodlab/reinstatement_2022')

# output directories
data_dir <- "data/"
fig_dir <- 'figures/'

indir <- '/dfs7/swaruplab/smorabit/collab/woodlab/reinstatement_2022/data/'


# load the UMI counts gene expression matrix
X <- Matrix::readMM(paste0(indir,'harmony_annotated_counts.mtx'))

# load harmony matrix
X_harmony <- read.table(paste0(indir, 'harmony_reduction.csv'), sep=',', header=TRUE, row.names=1)

# load the cell & gene metadata table:
cell_meta <- read.table(paste0(indir, 'harmony_annotated_cell_meta.csv'), sep=',', header=TRUE, row.names=1)
# rownames(cell_meta) <- cell_meta$X; cell_meta <- cell_meta %>% select(-c(X))

gene_meta <- read.table(paste0(indir, 'harmony_annotated_gene_meta.csv'), sep=',', header=TRUE, row.names=1)

# get the umap from cell_meta:
umap <- cell_meta[,c('UMAP_1', 'UMAP_2')]

# set the rownames and colnames for the expression matrix:
# for Seurat, rows of X are genes, cols of X are cells
colnames(X) <- rownames(cell_meta)
rownames(X) <- rownames(gene_meta)
rownames(X_harmony) <- rownames(cell_meta)
rownames(umap) <- rownames(cell_meta)

# create a Seruat object:
seurat_obj <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = X,
  meta.data = cell_meta,
  assay = "RNA",
  project = "Reinstatement_2022",
  min.features = 0,
  min.cells = 0
)

# set harmony
seurat_obj@reductions$harmony <- Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = as.matrix(X_harmony),
  key="PC",
  assay="RNA"
)

# set UMAP
seurat_obj@reductions$umap <- Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = as.matrix(umap),
  key="UMAP",
  assay="RNA"
)

###########################################################
# set cluster factor levels:
###########################################################

seurat_obj$annotation <- factor(
  as.character(seurat_obj$annotation),
  levels = c(
    'MHb1', 'MHb2', 'MHb3', 'MHb4', 'MHb5',
    'LHb1', 'LHb2', 'LHb3', 'LHb4', 'LHb5', 'LHb6',
    'PHb1', 'PHb2', 'PHb3',
    'ASC1', 'ASC2', 'ASC3',
    'OPC', 'ODC1', 'ODC2', 'ODC3', 'MG',  'PER', 'END', 'EPD'
  )
)

seurat_obj$cell_type<- factor(
  as.character(seurat_obj$cell_type),
  levels = c(
    'MHb', 'LHb', 'PHb',
    'ASC', 'OPC', 'ODC', 'MG', 'PER', 'END', 'EPD'
  )
)


seurat_obj$Sample<- factor(
  as.character(seurat_obj$Sample),
  levels = c(
    'Sample-1', 'Sample-2', 'Sample-3',
    'Sample-4', 'Sample-5', 'Sample-8',
    'Sample-11', 'Sample-14', 'Sample-16',
    'Sample-9', 'Sample-13'
  )
)

seurat_obj$Group <- factor(
  as.character(seurat_obj$Group),
  c('Reinstatement', 'NR')
)

seurat_obj$Assignment <- factor(
  as.character(seurat_obj$Assignment),
  c('Group1', 'Group2', 'Group3')
)

###########################################################

# normalize
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)

# make a test plot of the umap:
p1 <- DimPlot(seurat_obj, group.by='annotation', label=TRUE, pt.size=0.1) + NoLegend()
pdf(paste0(fig_dir, 'test_umap.pdf'),  width=6, height=6, useDingbats=FALSE)
p1
dev.off()

# make a test plot of the umap:
p <- VlnPlot(seurat_obj, group.by='annotation', features='Tac2', pt.size=0) + NoLegend()
pdf(paste0(fig_dir, 'test_vlnplot.pdf'),  width=8, height=4, useDingbats=FALSE)
p
dev.off()

# save data:
saveRDS(seurat_obj, file=paste0(data_dir, 'Reinstatement_2022_seurat.rds'))

```
